changelog:
#Version 1.5.0:
What's new:
* Configurable Translation Caching:
  - Added a new "Cache translations" setting in LinguaPal Settings (disabled by default).
  - When disabled (default), LinguaPal queries the AI model anew each time you translate, making it easy to re-translate text if a previous response was inaccurate or incomplete.
  - If you prefer immediate cached results for repeated text, you can re-enable translation caching at any time in settings.
